subject: Request to include SOC 2 attestation language in case study for OliveTech
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 29 Oct 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: OliveTech asks to reference our SOC 2 in their case study

Hi Mina / Karthik,

OliveTech's marketing team sent over a case study draft and asked to include a short line referencing that Redwood is SOC 2 attested. They attached the draft and suggested sentence: "Redwood Inference is SOC 2 Type II attested (2025)."

Can we approve a public sentence like that? Jason says legal has looked at their side but wants our written permission to publish the attestation language and a copy of the attestation summary PDF (they plan to host it on their site).

Attachments: OliveTech_case_study_draft_v3.docx (DOCX)

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Oct 2025 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OliveTech asks to reference our SOC 2 in their case study

Thanks for the flag — quick notes:
- We can allow a short, non-technical public statement referencing our SOC 2 attestation, but we should control the exact wording and which artifacts they host.
- We do NOT publish the full SOC 2 report publicly; we provide a public attestation summary PDF and an attestation statement that Marketing can cite.
- Need to confirm whether OliveTech intends to reproduce any excerpts from our report or quote sections verbatim — that requires legal review.

Can one of you ask Jason to send the exact sentence they want to print and confirm where they will host the PDF (their site or a link to our hosted summary)? If they want to host our summary on their site we need to add the link back to our canonical copy and include the attestation date.

Mina
Head of Customer Marketing | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
From: Jason Wu <jason.wu@olivetech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: OliveTech Marketing <marketing@olivetech.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Oct 2025 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OliveTech asks to reference our SOC 2 in their case study

Hi Marissa / Mina — thanks for taking this.

Attached is our latest case study draft. Our legal and marketing teams have reviewed the copy and are proposing the following short line: 
"Redwood Inference is SOC 2 Type II attested (controls as of July 2025)."

We would like to place that line in the sidebar of our case study and host the attestation summary PDF on our resources page with a link to your canonical copy. We will not reproduce any sections of your internal report.

Can you confirm:
1) Whether that wording is acceptable as-is?
2) If you can provide the public attestation summary PDF we can link to and host?
3) Any logo or attribution requirements we should follow?

Attachments: OliveTech_case_study_draft_v3.docx (DOCX)

Best,
Jason Wu
Head of Marketing, OliveTech
jason.wu@olivetech.com | +1 212-555-0099
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jason Wu <jason.wu@olivetech.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 02 Nov 2025 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OliveTech asks to reference our SOC 2 in their case study

Hi Jason — thanks, that's helpful. Short answers below and a suggested final sentence.

1) Approved wording: "Redwood Inference is SOC 2 Type II attested (controls as of July 2025)." That wording is fine — please use it verbatim.
2) Hosting: we prefer you link to our canonical public attestation summary (PDF). We can provide the summary PDF for inclusion and a short attribution line. We do not permit hosting the full internal SOC 2 report on third-party sites.
3) Logo/attribution: please use our brand guidelines (I attached the one-page usage rules) — brief: white-space around logo, no color changes, and include the attribution text below the logo.

Suggested sentence for the sidebar (ready to paste):
"Redwood Inference is SOC 2 Type II attested (controls as of July 2025). For details see Redwood's public attestation summary."

I'm attaching a public attestation summary PDF and a small brand guide. If you plan on using any direct quotes or excerpts beyond the single-line attribution above, we'll need a short legal acknowledgment and our Marketing/Legal to sign off.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Attestation_v2025-07-summary.pdf (PDF, public-attestation-summary), Redwood_Brand_Guidelines_onepage.pdf (PDF)

– Karthik
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
